output.reason: The evidence shows that at least one penal-charges circular (“Fair Lending Practice - Penal Charges in Loan Accounts (2023)”) was withdrawn/repealed by a 2025 consolidation with effect from 2025-11-28, and therefore is no longer in force as of 2026-11-23. However, the claim is phrased broadly (“older penal-charges circulars”) and the evidence does not establish that *all* older penal-charges circulars were withdrawn/superseded. Also, while the evidence includes guidance that REs “shall not introduce any additional component to the rate of interest,” it does not directly connect withdrawal to “no current allowance for adding penal interest to the loan rate” in the precise manner asserted.
